newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips edge higher, trading curbs lifted.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips edge higher, trading curbs lifted.

text.p: U.S. blue chips continued to recover from mid-afternoon lows, clawing back from a 75-point loss to edge higher.
New York Stock Exchange lifted trading curbs at 1432 EDT/1832 GMT.
The Dow Industrials were up 9.29 points or 0.12 percent at 7703.95.
Nasdaq remained lower, off 9.14 points or 0.59 percent at 1552.89
The long bond was up 8/32 to yield 6.53 percent.
